method: bounded 8051 instruction simulation of the inserted DRCS loader and HUD helpers
limitations: The test emulates only the inserted loader/HUD and the patched score renderer.
The existing screen-clear routine (0x0984) and display-address routine (0x19D4) are deterministic stubs here; their target implementation was inspected separately.
This does not simulate all gameplay, Pong, IR hardware, the OSD analog output, or the physical TV. No external Flash was written.
